open_vagueness.text: xteink feat/issue-1 is local-only (unpushed; xteink#3 asks for it to be pushed/merged) — the code culture-library would cite exists only on this host and may move under it

Transcript EPUB format is unseen (embodiment v3; no transcript in the 2026-10-24 catalog) — whether segment start/end/speaker survive decides if the library reader can jump to a moment like pocketchat does
The 50 MiB upload cap is xteink's e-reader limit; large PDFs and scanned books may exceed it, and no size distribution of the operator's PDFs was measured

scope_entries.finding: Live library behind ebooks.culture.dev: /api/library CRUD with sha256 dedup, kinds book|article only, formats epub/bmp/txt (MD/HTML→EPUB via pandoc, PDF 415), 50 MiB cap + zip-bomb checks, SQLite + `files/<aa>/<sha256>`; 17 items / 36 MB; GET /api/library is 401 without an xtk_ key
xteink#3 (open) splits library→ebooks-cli, device side stays; ebooks-cli is a bare template scaffold with no library code — the destination is unclaimed and culture-library can take it
Two tunnels: ebooks.culture.dev→api:8780 (Access SSO allow-list) and xteink.culture.dev→api:8781 (--no-access, device keys); server verifies Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion itself; MCP :8782 LAN-only
xtk_ API keys are hash-only bearer tokens with no scopes — any key can delete items and mint keys

library.push is the only publisher today: daily 05:00 Asia/Jerusalem newspaper EPUB, kind=article, POST /api/library then POST `/api/devices/<id>/queue`, Bearer grant:XTEINK_PUSH_API_KEY; base_url is actor data (config change) but paths, kind and the queue step are code
Transcription writes only local `transcript.<model>.json` under `output_dir/<audio_sha256>/`; nothing pushes transcripts to any library — a new step/action is needed

Landing zone by design: Mongo docs + files tree `<YYYY>/<MM>/<id>/{meta.json`,transcript.*,summary.md,audio.m4a} (39 recordings, ~103 MB audio); outbound only events.jsonl / MQTT; sensitive filter gates shared destinations; no library/ebooks references; access.py is a reusable stdlib Access verifier

Exported+challenged spec (no code, plan has 0 tasks) already names culture-library at library.culture.dev as the knowledge home (c30), binds via a GET-only seam on xteink's contract (c12/c13/c15), reconciles by (id, sha256) (c33), and confirms boundary c26 'Gwen never writes to the library' — a diary in the library reverses c26; v4 parks culture-library's contract/auth as unknown
Gwen's memory is eidetic (files backend, gwen-ingest private scope); no diary concept exists; daemon writes must default private

remote-login setup provisions tunnel+DNS+Access (dry-run default, --shushu seals tokens); teardown by hostname; redirects only via cf-redirect-create.sh (zone Single Redirect, non-additive, needs a proxied DNS record)
Records are short text+metadata, no blobs or chunking, embeds all candidates per recall — fits a diary, not book-body search
Scaffold only: CLI introspection verbs, dependencies=[], no server/compose/deploy; CLAUDE.md mandates zero runtime deps and 'spec it before building'

~75 repos carry devague records: ~2,000 .devague files (651 frames, 578 plans, 363 reviews, 267 questions, 253 deliveries) plus exported md; mostly tracked, but reachy-mini-cli/culture-guide/notion-agent/agentculture-cli/reachy-lobes gitignore .devague and many repos have untracked in-progress frames (e.g. embodiment's drafting plan)
106 extra .devague directories live in git worktrees — a naive crawl duplicates them

129 repos: 112 PUBLIC, 17 PRIVATE (guildmaster, mjolnir-agent, cultureagent, jetson-containers-agent, katvan, rollout-cli, steward, culture-agent-template, reterminal-cli, grant, devex, operator-cli, agtag, culture-guide, culture-core, agent-lifecycle, identity-cli)

Frames/plans/deliveries are versioned JSON (schema_version 5) on a deterministic, offline-only CLI; export renders spec-md with a Scope exploration section — the library reads these files, it cannot ask devague to do anything networked
origin points at github.com/agentculture/culture-guide.git — a local clone's directory name is not a reliable repo identity; key repo docs by remote URL

Probed live: library.db schema + pragma + queue ids, culture-rules push gate, frame schema versions across ~/git, remote dedup, xteink backups, stt-he lane. Not probed: Access behaviour for headless clients, embedding cost for 2,949 records + book bodies, PDF sizes
